This establishes a reachable evaluator/proxy channel, but no human-verified reward-hacking episode or isolation test is supplied.",

No bypass or contingent execution condition is required, and documented unsandboxed arbitrary code supports high confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts within the agent process, while loss in a separate victim system is not established.
